title: Time Jump — 19:45

fields.narration: Time jump: It is now 19:45 on Friday, March 13, 2026. Six ICU patients have been transferred to receiving hospitals via ambulance and school bus. The PACU overflow is now at three patients. Three expectant patients are receiving comfort care in designated areas with family present. The replacement core switch has arrived and is in the data center. The installation team will begin the replacement at 21:30. The hospital census remains at 351. The ED holds 58 patients. The EHR remains read-only on 60 workstations. The interface engine ORRMC-INT01 continues to block two-way messaging. The lab and PACS remain down. The system-wide downtime continues.

instructorNote: This jump sets up the return-to-record phase. Players must now begin restoring documentation and validating records against paper logs. Watch for any attempt to re-enter data into the EHR without formal review.
